# Monyx API Market

> Pay-per-pull Solana data APIs for agents. No API keys, no accounts. Every
> endpoint answers HTTP 402 with a quote; pay it in devnet SOL and repeat the
> request with the transaction signature.

Base: https://nvfxdzxdlizznrknmunl.supabase.co/functions/v1/monyx-market
Catalog (free, JSON): GET /catalog
Public receipts (free): GET /ledger

## Protocol
1. GET /api/<name>?<params>  ->  402, body.accepts[0] = { payTo, maxAmountRequired, extra: { lamports, reference, expiresAt } }
2. Send a devnet SystemProgram.transfer from your key to `payTo` for at least `lamports`.
   Append `reference` to that instruction's keys as { isSigner: false, isWritable: false }.
   Wait for commitment "confirmed". Quotes live 300 seconds.
3. GET /api/<name>?<same params>  with header  X-PAYMENT: <signature>  ->  200 { api, receipt, data }
   Response header X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE is base64 JSON of the receipt.

One signature buys one pull for the exact params quoted. If the upstream fails
(502), repeat step 3 with the same signature; up to 3 attempts are honoured.

## Endpoints
- pulse    0.00005 SOL  net=mainnet|devnet          slot, epoch progress, TPS
- price    0.00005 SOL                              SOL/USD, 24h change, market cap
- profile  0.0005 SOL   address, net                balance, tokens, activity, failure rate
- trace    0.001 SOL    address, limit(5-40), net   counterparties and SOL/token flows
- tx       0.0003 SOL   signature, net              plain-English transaction breakdown
- token    0.0005 SOL   mint, net                   supply, authorities, holder concentration

Human interface: https://www.monyx.pro/pro/
